profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity, lasting traits) and estar (location, current state, so most feelings: estar + adjective). tener + noun covers physical and some emotional states (tener miedo, tener ganas). Psych verbs with indirect object pronouns (me gusta, me preocupa, me molesta) put the feeler in the object slot. Reflexive change-of-state verbs (enojarse, preocuparse, alegrarse) name getting into a feeling. Adjectives agree in gender and number (cansado/cansada). Politeness marked by tú/usted; ustedes for plural 'you'. Negation with no before the verb; yes/no questions by intonation. Closed sets: subject pronouns, indirect object pronouns (me, te, le, nos, les).
